style.name: panelcard
style.css: font-family:'Patrick Hand','Comic Neue',cursive; font-size:16px; color:#232840; line-height:1.45;

layer.name: panel_releases
layer.html: [h2]RELEASES[/h2] [b]SM-011[/b] — Inlet Knight, 'Harbor Lights' LP[br] [b]SM-010[/b] — Various, 'Night Bus Vol. 2' cassette[br] [b]SM-009[/b] — Moss Choir, 'Overcast' EP[br][br] [i]full discography lands with the content pass — for now, keep digging.[/i]

layer.name: panel_catalog
layer.html: [h2]CATALOG[/h2] every tape on the wall, alphabetized badly on purpose.[br][br] [i]searchable catalog wires in next — ask the person at the desk.[/i]

layer.name: panel_artists
layer.html: [h2]ARTISTS[/h2] the poster wall keeps the family tree: touring bands, one-off collabs, that project nobody will confirm exists.[br][br] [i]artist pages arrive with the content pass.[/i]

layer.name: panel_about
layer.html: [h2]ABOUT[/h2] STEREO-MART RECORDS — an independent label run from a desk buried in demo tapes. underground sound, musical discovery, coffee permanently going cold.[br][br] support your local record store.

layer.name: panel_contact
layer.html: [h2]CONTACT[/h2] slide it through the mail slot:[br][br] demos — [b]demos@stereo-mart.com[/b][br] everything else — [b]hello@stereo-mart.com[/b][br][br] [i](a real form arrives with the content pass.)[/i]

layer.name: panel_store
layer.html: [h2]THE STORE[/h2] vinyl, tapes, shirts and stickers — the web store connects here soon. until then the door stays propped open.[br][br] [i]storefront checkout wires in next.[/i]

layer.name: panel_player
layer.html: [h2]LISTENING STATION[/h2] put the headphones on. the music player (with the label's previews) docks into this panel in the content pass.[br][br] [i]side A, quiet volume, no autoplay — promise.[/i]
